field.name: endpointUrl
field.description: A style document's URL, a tile URL template ({z}, {x}, {y}) or a geocoder's base URL; empty for an archive root

field.name: resourceRoot
field.description: For self-hosted archives: the ResourceFacade location their registered layers are under

field.name: attribution
field.description: The attribution the map shows with this provider's layers, plain text, each part separated by a line break; termsUrl and the layer's own attribution beside it

field.name: attributionUrls
field.description: The links of the attribution's parts, in order, one a line

field.name: allowedOperations
field.description: What it is used for, comma separated: style, tiles, geocode, reverse, search, autocomplete. A geocoder is asked only when it is empty or names geocode or search

field.name: requestsPerSecond
requestsPerDay
field.description: The most requests this installation sends a geocoder in a calendar day (UTC), enforced across the cluster by MapProviderDayCount; empty for no limit

field.name: cachePolicy
field.description: What may keep its answers: none (or empty), private (the user's browser only: this server keeps nothing) or shared (this server, for every user)

field.name: cacheSeconds
field.description: How long a shared answer may be kept; empty for the provider's own Cache-Control max-age (nothing kept when it gives none, or no-store)

field.name: proxyRequests
field.description: Y: browsers reach the provider's style, TileJSON, tiles and sprites through this server (LocalMap.xml providerProxy), which adds its key; the provider then sees this server's address, not the user's, but still the area viewed: not a claim of complete location privacy (§4.2)

field.name: apiKey
field.description: The provider's key, write-only: never returned, exported, logged or sent to a browser (a proxied provider's key stays on the server)

field.name: apiKeyParameter
field.description: How a proxied request carries apiKey: a query parameter's name (key when empty; api_key, access_token), or header:Name for a request header

field.name: proxyPaths
field.description: A proxied provider's rules, one a line, as its last passing test found them in its style, TileJSON and layers (MapProviders.js): "doc path[?query]" an exact path, "sprite path" with .json, .png, @2x.json or @2x.png after it, "tile template[?query]" its {z}, {x}, {y} whole numbers; the only paths the proxy forwards, each with its own query; for an OGC service (MapOgc.js) "wms path[?query]", "wmts path[?query]" and "wfs path[?query]" its operation's path with the parameters its requests may add, and "wmtsrest template" a WMTS tile template. Written by the test

field.name: capabilitiesJson
field.description: An OGC service's (MPK_WMS, MPK_WMTS, MPK_WFS) capabilities as its last passing test read them (MapOgc.js): {service, version, url, kvp, cors, formats, layers: [{name, title, styles, crs, formats, bounds, time, matrixSets, template}], crsLists, styleLists, matrixSets}, a layer's crs and styles the index of a list kept once; at most 2,000 layers and 2 MB. The Configuration's Add OGC layer picks from it and the effective configuration builds a WMTS layer's tile grid from it, so no browser reads the capabilities. Written by the test, never by a form

field.name: disabled
field.description: Y: no layer of it is drawn and nothing is sent to it but the test of test#Connection. Set by an administrator, or by store#Connection when the endpoint changed, until a test passes

field.name: allowPrivateNetwork
field.description: N: the server sends nothing to a loopback, private or link-local address for this provider (moqui_core::outbound). Empty: as N on a production instance, as Y on another, as NetworkPrinter's

moqui.basic.Enumeration.description: Geocoder: US Census (street-range interpolation, US addresses)
OGC Web Feature Service (WFS 2.0.0, read as GeoJSON)

field.name: sourceUrl
field.description: A path of this server (starting with /), or with a provider a URL or template under its endpoint; never sent to a browser while maps@external-requests is false and it is outside this server

field.name: resourceLocation
field.description: A registered resource (ResourceFacade location), served through the map-source transition, never as a path to the browser

field.name: styleLocation
field.description: The style document: a URL of the provider, or a resource location

field.name: assetsLocation
field.description: Where the style's fonts, sprites and icons are served from, so a local style contacts no outside font host (§4.1)

field.name: crs
field.description: The source CRS, EPSG:3857 when empty

field.name: attribution
field.description: The layer's own attribution, beside its provider's

field.name: sourceEdition
field.description: The source's edition or release (Natural Earth 4.1.0)

field.name: sourceRevision
field.description: The registered revision's content address (an LFS oid, a SHA-256), the strong validator and the revision in the map-source URL (§5)

field.name: sourceTag
field.description: The strong tag the registered revision is sent with (the ETag): sha256-(hex) of an LFS object, a content blob or a digest, or of a file on disk as it was read when registered (MapSourceServices.register#ArchiveLayer)

field.name: sourceSize
field.description: The registered revision's size in bytes

field.name: sourceVersionName
field.description: On storage that keeps versions (git://, dbresource://), the version registered: resourceLocation#sourceVersionName is what the map-source transition sends, so a later commit or write does not change what a map already drawing reads until the layer is registered again

field.name: sourceAddressKind
field.description: What sourceRevision is: git-lfs, content-blob, digest (a small dbresource:// file kept in its row) or file (a file on disk, its SHA-256)

field.name: sourceModifiedDate
field.description: A file on disk: its modification time when registered; a file changed in place since is refused (409) until the layer is registered again

field.name: driveId
field.description: The drive resourceLocation is under, whose access (a member, a share of the file or a folder above it) a viewer needs too, checked on every request; empty for a location outside every drive, which only an administrator registers

field.name: ogcLayers
field.description: An OGC layer (MLF_WMS, MLF_WMTS, MLF_WFS): the names its provider's capabilities advertise, a WMS layer's comma separated (LAYERS), a WMTS layer's identifier, a WFS feature type's name (TYPENAMES)

field.name: ogcStyles
field.description: The style of each of ogcLayers (WMS STYLES, comma separated; a WMTS style's identifier); empty for the default

field.name: ogcFormat
field.description: The image format of a WMS or WMTS layer (image/png), the output format of a WFS layer (application/json); one its capabilities advertise

field.name: ogcMatrixSet
field.description: A WMTS layer's tile matrix set, one its capabilities link it to

field.name: ogcTime
field.description: A value of the layer's time dimension (TIME), when it has one; empty for its default

field.name: ogcSingleImage
field.description: Y: a WMS layer is drawn as one image of the view (ImageWMS) rather than as tiles (TileWMS)

field.name: rasterJson
field.description: A Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF layer (MLF_COG): what its header holds, read when it was registered or its provider tested (MapSourceServices.read#CogHeader): {bands, sampleType, compression, width, height, tileWidth, overviews, nodata, epsg, bounds (in its CRS), statistics [[band, min, max]]}, and its default band settings {rgb [r, g, b] or band, min, max, colormap}, which a user's preferences or saved view override

field.name: adapterKey
field.description: A dynamic layer: the registered adapter whose find#LayerFeatures answers a viewport, after its own access check

field.name: viewPermission
field.description: A permission a viewer must hold to be offered the layer; empty for every user who may open a map

moqui.basic.Enumeration.description: Delimited text (WKT, WKB or latitude and longitude)

field.name: projectionId
field.description: Its code: EPSG:32633

field.name: proj4Definition
field.description: +proj=utm +zone=33 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs

field.name: axisOrder
field.description: The authority's axis order: enu (easting, northing; the default for a projected CRS) or neu (northing first, as EPSG:3035 and a geographic CRS are), which a GML URN of it gives

field.name: minLongitude
field.description: The area of use, WGS84 degrees: where a map in it is drawn and its view constrained

field.name: projectedExtent
field.description: The extent in its own units (minx,miny,maxx,maxy), for a view drawn in it; empty to take its area of use's

field.name: transformNote
field.description: The datum shift to WGS84 and its accuracy, in words

field.name: sourceNote
field.description: Where the definition came from

field.name: displayUnits
field.description: metric or imperial; empty for the user's locale

field.name: externalAccess
field.description: Y: a layer of it is drawn from an outside host, so it is not offered while maps@external-requests is false and readiness names its hosts for the page's CSP; N: it reaches only this server

field.name: allowedOverrides
field.description: What a user's preferences may change, comma separated: basemap, layers, extent, units

field.name: viewProjection
field.description: The projection the map is drawn in: EPSG:3857 (Web Mercator) when empty, EPSG:4326, or a projection of MapProjection (a polar or regional one). A basemap of vector tiles is drawn only in EPSG:3857, so such a basemap is refused in another, with the reason

field.name: path
field.description: The file's path in the drive, from its root

field.name: formatEnumId
field.description: The file's format: MLF_GEOJSON, MLF_TOPOJSON, MLF_ESRIJSON, MLF_GPX, MLF_KML, MLF_GML, MLF_WKT, MLF_WKB, MLF_CSV or MLF_SHAPEFILE

field.name: sourcePath
field.description: An overlay edited on the map whose file was not GeoJSON the map read whole: the original file, kept as it was; path is then the edited copy beside it (name.edited.geojson)

field.name: rejectedCount
field.description: Features left out for a geometry that is not sane

field.name: sourceCrs
field.description: EPSG:4326, or the CRS the file declared: EPSG:3857 or a projection of MapProjection, converted to WGS84 when it was read

field.name: crsTransform
field.description: What converting sourceCrs to WGS84 did (the provenance): the method, the ellipsoid and the datum shift with its accuracy; empty for WGS84

field.name: importNotes
field.description: What was not read or kept, a line each

field.name: tilesStatus
field.description: pending, running, ready, failed or cancelled; empty for an overlay drawn whole

field.name: tilesProgress
field.description: Percent of the zooms made

field.name: tilesCancel
field.description: Y: the run stops at its next zoom

field.name: tilesNote
field.description: Why the tiles failed, or what they hold

field.name: tilesPath
field.description: The archive's path in the file's drive

field.name: tilesRevision
field.description: The archive's content address, named in its tile URL

field.name: tilesModifiedDate
field.description: An archive in a drive on the server's disk, which has no content address: its modification time, checked with its size on each tile

field.name: tilesJobRunId
field.description: The MapOverlayTiles run making the tiles

field.name: west
field.description: The box, WGS84 degrees; a west east of its east crosses the antimeridian

field.name: profileId
field.description: The map profile its basemaps and configuration are read through, as the owner's map would read it; empty for the owner's own

field.name: basemapLayerIds
field.description: The basemap layers asked for, comma separated (registered PMTiles archives); empty for every archive basemap the profile offers the owner

field.name: statusNote
field.description: Why it failed, or what it holds

field.name: progress
field.description: Percent of the build done

field.name: cancelRequested
field.description: Y: the build stops between its batches of tiles

field.name: jobRunId
field.description: The MapPackageBuild run building it

field.name: revision
field.description: The build: 1, then one more for each Update. The download URL names it, and a request for another is 409

field.name: estimatedSize
field.description: The estimate's bytes when it was asked

field.name: location
field.description: The built zip: runtime://tmp/map-packages/{packageId}-{revision}.zip

field.name: sha256
field.description: The zip's SHA-256 (hex): its strong ETag is sha256-{sha256}

field.name: sourceRevisions
field.description: What it was cut from, as JSON: each basemap layer's and tiled overlay's registered revision when the build was asked ({layerId: revision}); a source registered again before or while it is cut fails the build

field.name: lastDownloadDate
field.description: The last download's first request; with builtDate what maps@package-keep-days counts from

moqui.basic.StatusItem.description: Expired (its file removed after maps@package-keep-days with no download)

field.name: userLoginKey
field.description: The device's UserLoginKey (its stored hash); empty for a request signed in otherwise

field.name: contextServiceName
field.description: Implements get#RecordMapContext; empty for a layer adapter

field.name: storeServiceName
field.description: Implements store#RecordLocation; empty for a read-only adapter, which offers no Choose location

field.name: featuresServiceName
field.description: Implements find#LayerFeatures; empty for a record adapter with no layer

field.name: routeApp
field.description: The app whose maps the row is for, as its mount of LocalMap passes it (routeApp: boss, home); empty for a row of every app's, used after the host app's own

field.name: urlTemplate
field.description: A path of this site, /apps/... or /qapps/..., with {name} placeholders of the link's parameters, each URL-encoded: /apps/myapp/Party/PartyDetail?partyId={partyId}

field.name: screenLocation
field.description: The screen whose grant opens the URL (the app's root or the screen itself), checked with the user's own grants: component://myapp/screen/MyApp.xml

field.name: priority
field.description: Lower first, among the rows of a key

field.name: componentName
field.description: The component that registers the row

field.name: sourceKey
field.description: At most 12 characters (a point ID is the Geo's ID, _ and this, within 40): CENSUS_ZCTA, GN_POSTAL

field.name: urlTemplate
field.description: Empty for an operator's file, which comes from an upload or a resource location

field.name: coverageGeoId
field.description: The country it covers; empty for a set read a country at a time (perCountry Y) or one that is global

field.name: perCountry
field.description: Y: a run names a country, the {country} of urlTemplate

field.name: countryCodes
field.description: For a set read a country at a time: the ISO alpha-2 codes of the countries its publisher has a file for, comma separated (GeoNames' 124), the countries Geo data's Import offers; empty for any country

field.name: sourceUrl
field.description: The publisher's page for the set, its documentation

field.name: dataSourceId
field.description: The DataSource of the Geo rows and points it makes

field.name: removingStamp
field.description: Set while remove#GeoData removes this set's rows, a batch at a time, and touched before each batch: an import of its source key and country, or another Remove of the set, is refused meanwhile; taken as abandoned when it has not changed for an hour

field.name: removingCountryGeoId
field.description: The country of the removal under way; empty for every country

moqui.basic.Enumeration.description: Census pipe-delimited text with a header
Operator CSV (country, code, place, admin codes, latitude, longitude, precision)
The county of each postal area

field.name: sourceUrl
field.description: The URL downloaded, its template expanded

field.name: sourceLocation
field.description: An operator's file: its resource location

field.name: checksum
field.description: SHA-256 of the file read, hex (64 characters)

field.name: errorLocation
field.description: Where the run failed: a step, or a line of the file

field.name: forced
field.description: Y: an administrator accepted a file with far fewer rows than the edition in use

field.name: queueId
field.description: The queue of an import of every country of a data set read a country at a time: its runs share it (the first run's ID), and each run, when it ends, starts the queue's next pending run
